description: Five fresh demo-only Robot Memory policies using all successful RGB-D replays from up to 250 released training demonstrations per task. Exact frozen code and original held-out outcomes.

memory.name: stage
memory.description: cue -> touch -> tilt -> settle; inferred progress, set when an act is chosen

memory.name: decisions
memory.description: number of decisions taken

memory.name: ball_xyz
memory.description: observed: world xyz of red ball (front-camera surface point) during the cue

memory.name: ball_pixels
memory.description: observed: ball pixel count of the stored sighting (confidence)

memory.name: ball_seen_step
memory.description: observed: frame step of the stored ball sighting

memory.name: ball_source
memory.description: front / wrist / none: camera of the stored ball sighting

memory.name: cups_seen
memory.description: observed: cups have appeared (cue over)

memory.name: target_xy
memory.description: inferred: TCP touch target = ball + expert mean offset

memory.name: contact_z
memory.description: measured: TCP z where descent stopped (contact or target)

memory.name: hold_rpy
memory.description: initial TCP roll/pitch/yaw kept as orientation goal

memory.name: note
memory.description: reason for the latest decision

memory.name: steps_done
memory.description: native steps executed so far (time index of the current frame); None at reset

memory.name: goal_xy
memory.description: bullseye centre [x, y] m from the front RGB-D (first frame where visible); persists

memory.name: goal_radius
memory.description: measured bullseye radius m (sanity check, expected ~0.1)

memory.name: ball_track
memory.description: observed ball centres [x, y, t, npix] (front camera sphere fit), last 40

memory.name: ball_fit
memory.description: straight-line fit [x0, vx, y0, vy]: ball(t) = (x0+vx t, y0+vy t), samples t>=2 before contact

memory.name: fit_source
memory.description: 'observed' (fit from >=2 samples) or 'prior' (bullseye x - 0.2 m, vy 0.022)

memory.name: phase
memory.description: 'approach' until a ball sample deviates >1 cm from the line near contact, then 'deflected'

memory.name: contact_t
memory.description: step at which the deflection was observed (inferred, one step before deviation)

memory.name: theta_deg
memory.description: planned wall angle from +y toward +x, degrees (yaw target = -theta)

memory.name: yaw_target
memory.description: TCP yaw target rad

memory.name: wall
memory.description: TCP xy target of the wall pose

memory.name: contact_point
memory.description: predicted ball centre at contact

memory.name: t_contact
memory.description: predicted contact step

memory.name: plan_frozen
memory.description: True once t >= t_contact-4: wall pose no longer replanned

memory.name: plan_feasible
memory.description: planner thinks the arm can be in place before t_contact

memory.name: plan_ttot
memory.description: predicted step at which the ball enters the bullseye

memory.name: plan_delta
memory.description: signed predicted miss distance of the deflected path from the centre m

memory.name: plan_margin
memory.description: angular margin (deg) of the deflected path for staying within 0.09 m

memory.name: rot_rate
memory.description: online estimate of achievable rotation rad/step (saturated steps)

memory.name: lin_rate
memory.description: online estimate of achievable translation m/step (saturated z steps)

memory.name: prev_tcp
memory.description: TCP pose at the end of the previous decision

memory.name: prev_cmd
memory.description: pose command of the previous decision [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw]

memory.name: frame_step
memory.description: frame.step of the current frame (diagnostic only)

memory.name: stage
memory.description: cue_wait | delay | touch : current phase inferred from front-camera blob counts

memory.name: cue_color
memory.description: observed colour name of the single cue cube (first cue frame)

memory.name: cue_chroma
memory.description: normalised mean RGB of the cue cube; used to match the target

memory.name: cue_first_step
memory.description: frame step where the cue was first seen (-1 none)

memory.name: cue_frames
memory.description: number of frames the cue cube was visible

memory.name: delay_frames
memory.description: number of empty-table frames after the cue

memory.name: cubes_step
memory.description: frame step where the candidate cubes appeared (-1 not yet)

memory.name: cube_positions
memory.description: candidate cube [x, y, z_top] world metres at appearance

memory.name: cube_colors
memory.description: colour names of the candidate cubes, same order

memory.name: target_pos
memory.description: matched cube centre [x, y, z] world metres

memory.name: target_conf
memory.description: colour-match margin confidence 0..1

memory.name: touch_attempts
memory.description: number of act_touch calls issued

memory.name: last_step
memory.description: latest processed frame step

memory.name: notes
memory.description: anomalies observed

memory.name: y_offset
memory.description: TCP y shift (m) keeping a finger off a neighbouring cube; 0 normally

memory.name: cue_code
memory.description: RGB-bit colour code (e.g. '010'=green) of the single cue cube seen before candidates appear; null until seen

memory.name: cue_rgb
memory.description: mean RGB of the cue cube pixels in the front camera

memory.name: cue_step
memory.description: native step of the frame where the cue was first observed

memory.name: cand_step
memory.description: native step at which >=2 cubes (candidates) first appeared

memory.name: candidates
memory.description: candidate cubes at appearance: code, world top-face pos [x,y,top_z], pixel count

memory.name: target_code
memory.description: colour code of the chosen candidate

memory.name: target_pos
memory.description: world [x, y, top_z] of the chosen cube from the front camera

memory.name: target_conf
memory.description: 1 exact colour match, 0.5 duplicate colour, 0.3 nearest RGB, 0 unknown cue

memory.name: stage
memory.description: wait_cue | wait_candidates | touch | no_target

memory.name: steps_seen
memory.description: largest native frame step observed

memory.name: last_result
memory.description: truncated result of the previous act tool

memory.name: stage
memory.description: cue | wait | touch: current stage

memory.name: decisions
memory.description: number of decisions taken this episode

memory.name: cue_color
memory.description: palette name of the cue cube observed before it vanished

memory.name: cue_confidence
memory.description: fraction of cue top-face pixels in the winning colour class

memory.name: cue_step
memory.description: frame step at which the cue colour was read

memory.name: target_xyz
memory.description: world top-face centre of the matching cube measured when the cubes appeared

memory.name: touch_attempts
memory.description: touch attempts issued (selects the fallback mode)

memory.name: home_rpy
memory.description: start TCP roll/pitch/yaw held during motion

memory.name: notes
memory.description: short log of act outcomes
